voice.summary: Talks like a good coworker in a hallway: casual, short and warm, with room for an emoji. Replies are brief, and the interface stays out of the way of the conversation.
dos: Keep system messages to a few words
Use first names and plain language
Match the friendly tone of a message thread
donts: No corporate announcements in a chat window

taglines: Hello again, pick up where you left off
boilerplate: Parley is a team messenger that keeps conversations, calls and quick reactions in one calm, fast-moving place for small groups.

microcopy.error: Message not sent. Tap to retry.

logo.note: A speech bubble is the plain, instantly legible sign of a messenger.
